brand.hero_subtitle: Investigative journalism and in-depth analysis of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena, government disclosure, and emerging defense intelligence.

editorial.publication_description: a premium UAP/UFO intelligence publication known for rigorous analysis and compelling storytelling
rating_criteria: UAP/UFO Relevance (1-10): Is this about UAPs, UFOs, NHI (Non-Human Intelligence), military disclosure, congressional hearings, or whistleblower testimony?
Novelty & Newsworthiness (1-10): Is this breaking news, a major leak, or contains new investigative details? (Or is it rehashed old news?)
Source Credibility (1-10): Is this from a mainstream investigative outlet, credible journalist, government official, or just a random internet rumor?
editorial.research_focus: breaking UAP/UFO disclosure topic — official statements, press releases, legislative amendments (such as NDAA UAP provisions), key figures (government officials, whistleblowers, departments)
editorial.image_style: Prefer: dramatic skies, government buildings, radar screens, mysterious aerial phenomena, document close-ups, congressional settings
